description: This file defines the interface 'Zend_Loader_Autoloader_Interface' for the Zend Framework's autoloading system. It declares a single method, 'autoload', which is intended to load a class by name.

classes.name: Zend_Loader_Autoloader_Interface
classes.description: An interface specifying the autoload method for classes.

methods.name: autoload
methods.description: Abstract method to load a class given its name; returns false if unable to load, or the class name if successful.
